## Purpose and evidence standard

This note covers the BLADE business products used by `fplida`. BLADE is not a
person-level PLIDA dataset, but it is important for employer/business linkage
and future DIL-backed builds.

| Evidence label | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Official | Backed by an official public source linked here. |
| Local generator | Observed in current `fplida` code, tests, generated smoke data, or BLADE metadata files. |
| Unresolved | No source was found in this pass. Do not use as calibration truth. |

## Source documents

| Source | Use |
|---|---|
| `inst/blade_metadata/tables.csv`, `variables.csv`, `keys.csv` | BLADE table, variable, valid-response, and key metadata. |
| `R/generate_blade.R`, `tests/testthat/test-generate_blade.R` | Current local BLADE generator and regression checks. |
| `inst/foundations/blade.toml` | Local foundation assumptions. |
| [ABS BLADE overview](https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics/data-integration/integrated-data/business-longitudinal-analysis-data-environment-blade) | Official BLADE context. |
| [ABS BLADE microdata/TableBuilder/DataLab page](https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics/microdata-tablebuilder/available-microdata-tablebuilder/business-longitudinal-analysis-data-environment-blade) | Official product/access context and warning to use explanatory notes/source agency material. |

## Source-backed coverage decisions

| Product area | What the research source supports | What is still not found |
|---|---|---|
| BLADE scope and sources | ABS BLADE pages support that BLADE combines tax, ABS survey, trade, IP, ASIC, DEWR, and other administrative sources for active businesses and business performance/productivity analysis. | Public ABS pages do not provide full code labels for all generated BLADE variables; use `inst/blade_metadata/variables.csv` as the local DIL-style schema source. |
| Business identifiers and key products | Local BLADE metadata and generated tests support the key products and identifier-link fields used by the package. | I did not find a public codebook for every generated key-product match flag or one-to-many/many-to-one indicator. |
| BAS, PAYG, BIT, STP, EEH, and survey-style tables | ABS BLADE pages identify major data themes and source agencies; local metadata identifies generated table/variable names and valid-response notes where populated. | Public source-agency pages still need to be attached before generated financial, payroll, and survey fields are interpreted beyond local schema/valid-response metadata. |
| Generated distributions | Local smoke output and tests support implementation ranges and consistency checks. | I did not find official source-data distributions for the generated BLADE financial/payroll amounts or flags. |

## Product inventory

The local BLADE metadata lists sixty-two tables, more than five thousand
variable rows, and key products linking business identifiers. Tables include
standard and requestable products. The generator supports a DIL-backed
business spine and selected high-use tables for integration tests.

| Metadata file | Current role |
|---|---|
| `tables.csv` | Table number, sheet, table name, product name, reference period, scope, and header-row metadata. |
| `variables.csv` | Variable names, levels, valid responses, and available periods by table. |
| `keys.csv` | Appendix key products, including identifier link keys. |

## Variable-level schema register

Every generated variable observed in this pass for this guide is listed in
[`schema-registers/schema-register-blade.csv`](schema-registers/schema-register-blade.csv).
The register records R type, sampled generated missingness, sampled generated
domains/distributions, and BLADE metadata fields where a variable-name match
was found. Treat those sampled domains/distributions as implementation evidence
only, not as official source data.

A rendered variable evidence appendix for this guide is available at [`variable-evidence-appendices/blade-variable-evidence.qmd`](variable-evidence-appendices/blade-variable-evidence.qmd). It contains one row per generated variable with observed generated values or distributions, local metadata/crosswalk status, and unresolved-source caveats.

| Dataset | Generated variable rows | Direct PLIDA metadata matches | BLADE metadata basis |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| `BLADE` | 825 | Not applicable | `inst/blade_metadata/tables.csv`, `variables.csv`, and `keys.csv` |

BLADE is not joined to `inst/plida_metadata/` by `dataset + variable`, so the
PLIDA-match column in the central register is not a BLADE quality flag. Use
the BLADE metadata columns in the register for item names, valid-response
notes, and available-period evidence.

## Generated schema and value domains

The official BLADE microdata page says the Data Item List has limited
information and users should consult explanatory notes/source agency websites.
This guide therefore treats local metadata and tests as implementation
contracts, not as complete official codebooks.

### Key products

| Product | Variables | Expected values or distribution | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `blade-key-id-to-bn-key` | `bn`, `id`, `bg_id`, `key_version`, `tsid`, `one_abn_to_many_tau`, `many_abn_to_one_tau`, `match` | Business-number/person/business-group key product; match and many-to-one flags are local generated linkage indicators. | Local BLADE metadata/generator |
| `blade-key-cn-to-bn-key` | `cn`, `bn`, `cn_bn_version`, `tsid` | Company-number to business-number key product. | Local BLADE metadata/generator |

### Table 1 business frame / cross-sectional indicators

| Variable/group | Expected values or distribution | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| `bn`, `tsid` | Business number and time-series/business identifier; local tests check `tsid` shape/length. | Local generator/test |
| `x_anzsic06`, `d_div06`, `x_sisca08`, `x_sector` | Industry/division/sector classification fields. | Local metadata/generator; official labels unresolved |
| Health/private flags | Local business-status/industry flags generated from business spine. | Local generator |
| `x_itip`, `x_itw`, `x_gstp` | Local role/status codes tested in `n`, `0`, `1`, `L`. | Local tests |
| `x_gst_bn` | Blank or GST-style business number string in local tests. | Local tests |

### Business activity, payroll, tax, and survey tables

| Table/product area | Key variables | Expected values or distribution | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| Table 4 BAS | `bn`, `turnover`, `exports_amt`, `oexp`, `wages` | Local tests check `exports_amt <= turnover`, `turnover >= oexp`, and no `month_actioned` in BAS output. | Local tests |
| Table 5 PAYG | `bn`, `hcnt` and linked worker counts | Local tests compare PAYG headcount to linked person counts and allow mismatch diagnostics. | Local tests |
| Table 6 BIT | Company/business income-tax wage variables such as `c_totlwage`, `i_totlwage`, `p_totlwage`, `t_totlwage` | Local tests check that placeholder identifiers such as `cn` and `fn` are not emitted in this table and numeric wage fields are valid. | Local tests |
| Table 7 STP | `bn`, `stp_version`, `tsid`, `quarter`, `month_actioned`, `branch_number`, `d_total_payees`, `ed_*` pay amount/indicator fields | Local generated STP-business table; month/quarter and payee/earnings fields are synthetic BLADE business outputs, not the person-level STP table. | Local generator/smoke |
| Table 17 EEH | `id`, `eeh_version`, `tsid`, `s_groupid_eeh`, `eid_eeh`, earnings/hours fields, age category, full-time/part-time, occupation, pay frequency, rate of pay, sex, employment type, state | Local generated Employee Earnings and Hours-style table. | Local generator/smoke |
| Table 27 birthdate | `bn`, `bd_version`, `birth_date` | Local business birthdate table. | Local generator/smoke |

## Metadata schema use

For future builds, BLADE should be driven from `inst/blade_metadata` wherever
possible rather than hard-coded from memory. In particular:

| Metadata column | Build use |
|---|---|
| `Table.Number`, `Table.Name`, `Product.Name` | Stable table/product identification. |
| `Reference.Period`, `Available.Periods` | Decide whether a product/year should be emitted. |
| `Variable.Name`, `Variable.Level` | Validate generated column names and hierarchy. |
| `Valid.Response` | Source local categorical domains when populated. |
| `Scope` | Separate standard from requestable products. |

## Research uses and limits

BLADE is useful for employer/business linkage, firm characteristics, payroll
and tax/business activity examples, and tests of business-person linkage
through STP/PAYG-style tables. It is not a PLIDA person product and should not
be mixed into person-level guides without clear join semantics.

## Build implications

1. Keep BLADE guide and tests separate from PLIDA person products.
2. Use local BLADE metadata for schema validation, and use ABS/source-agency
   explanatory notes for semantic interpretation.
3. Preserve the generated key products because they are central to business
   linkage and BLADE-to-person examples.
4. Add coverage for more of the sixty-two metadata tables only when the
   variable-level `Valid.Response` and source-agency notes are available.
